description: Request and response bodies of the control internal API (/internal/v1/*) that the worker calls with the run capability token.

LockFileContent.description: How to obtain the content of one locked file: a short-lived download URL, or the text inline when the file is small text. Exactly one of blob_url and text is present.

ref.description: Asset reference of the entry the file belongs to.

version.description: Version of the entry the file belongs to.

path.description: Path of the file inside the bundle.

sha256.description: Hex sha256 of the content; the worker verifies it.

blob_url.description: Pre-signed object store URL of the content.

text.description: The content itself, for small UTF-8 text files.

GetLockResponse.description: A run lock and the means to fetch every file in it.

contents.description: One element per file of every entry of the lock.

ModelCredentials.description: Endpoint and short-lived key of an OpenAI-compatible model API, issued per segment from the tenant model profile. It never enters Temporal history.

params.description: Default request parameters of the profile, such as temperature or max_tokens.

ToolDecision.description: What the policy says about a call: allow, ask for approval, or deny.

GrantScope.description: How far a grant of allow_always reaches: the session, the user across sessions, or the whole workspace.

ToolRule.description: A policy rule for a tool.

pattern.description: Pattern the call arguments must match for the rule to apply; the rule applies to every call when absent.

PermissionGrant.description: A standing permission a user gave with allow_always or allow_session.

arg_pattern.description: Pattern the call arguments must match; every call of the tool when absent.

PolicySnapshot.description: Tool policy of the run as of the start of a segment: the tenant and workspace rules and the grants that turn ask into allow. A grant never overrides deny.

grants.description: Grants in force for the run's principal.

PersistGrantRequest.description: Records an allow_always (or allow_session) decision as a permission grant.

arg_pattern.description: Pattern the call arguments must match; every call of the tool when absent.

SecretGrant.description: A short-lived grant of a secret value, issued for a name the lock declares.

value.description: The secret value. It must not be logged, put in events or in Temporal payloads.

expires_at.description: When the grant stops being valid.
